title: decision.v1
description: One decision record: an architectural decision (SWE.2 BP3), or a decision of the detailed design or the build, decided by the person when a critical requirement depends on it and by the agent otherwise. Stored as one fenced ```yaml decision block in qf.yaml paths.decisions_dir/NNNN-<slug>.md; this schema validates the block. That the choice is one of the options, that the file name matches the ID, that IDs are unique, which fields decided_by needs, and that the agent decides no critical requirement are gate rules of verify_decision_records_gate. Shown to the person on the decisions page (agent/render_decisions_tool.py).

context.description: What forces the decision: the requirements, constraints and risks involved.

options.description: The alternatives considered — at least two, or it was no decision.

choice.description: The name of the option chosen.

consequences.description: What follows from the choice, good and bad.

decided_by.description: Who decides: person when a critical requirement depends on it (criticality high, or kind security), agent otherwise. Left out on a record of the architecture, which checkpoint 3 approves.

requirements.description: The requirements the decision serves, by UID.

question.description: decided_by person: the question the person is asked, in plain words, ending with '?'.

why_you.description: decided_by person: why the person is asked, in one plain sentence: the critical requirement it touches.

proposed_because.description: decided_by person, while proposed: why the choice is proposed; the person accepts it with Y.

answered_by.description: decided_by person, once accepted: who answered, by name.

not_critical.description: decided_by agent: why no critical requirement depends on it, so the person is not asked: 'Only how tags look; rated low at checkpoint 2.'

where.description: decided_by agent: where the choice is in the work, as path:line.

change_request.description: The change request the decision was made for, by issue number.
